FY2025 vendor-normalized fundamentals show revenue of 626159096000.0 TWD, a thin 1.7% operating margin and a net-cash balance sheet (net debt/EBITDA -1.10x). latest_fy.basis: Revenue for the period ended 2025-12-31, from the yfinance-statements vendor-normalized fundamentals series in data/market/6505-TW.json.

revenue_cagr_3y.basis: Three-year compound annual revenue growth computed as (626159096000.0 / 848048496000.0) ** (1/3) - 1 from the yfinance-statements revenue series, period ended 2022-12-31 to period ended 2025-12-31; 2022 was an energy-price spike year, so the negative CAGR is partly normalization off that base.

operating_margin.basis: Operating income 10878467000.0 divided by revenue 626159096000.0, both for the period ended 2025-12-31, from the yfinance-statements series. A thin margin typical of a merchant refiner and petrochemical producer between crack-spread cycles.

fcf_margin.basis: Free cash flow 37004270000.0 (operating cash flow 43492365000.0 less capex 6488095000.0, both period ended 2025-12-31) divided by revenue 626159096000.0.

net_debt_to_ebitda.basis: Net debt -26393530000.0 (total debt 21130412000.0 less cash 47523942000.0, period ended 2025-12-31) divided by an EBITDA proxy 24041473000.0 (operating income 10878467000.0 plus depreciation 13163006000.0, same period), from the yfinance-statements series. implied_fcf_cagr.basis: Free-cash-flow CAGR the current enterprise value 653760014000.0 implies over a 5-year explicit period on base FCF 37004270000.0, solved by bisection at a 0.09 discount rate and 0.025 terminal growth over vendor-normalized (yfinance-statements) statements.
